title: Fresh, with definition.
label: Fresh bridal
question: How do you define the eyes and still keep the whole look light?
idea: Let the eye line do the work. Keep the surrounding colour soft.
effect: The eyes have a clear outline, while the luminous cheeks and rose lip keep the overall balance gentle.
notes: A fine outward line and fanned lashes give the eyes definition without a dense band of shadow.
Light catches the cheeks; a glossy rose lip adds colour without a hard edge.
Swept-back hair opens the face. A small white floral detail adds a quiet point of interest behind the ear.
adapt: Bring the eye definition, lip finish or hair shape that you like. We can discuss the balance around your own features, outfit and occasion.

title: Tradition, in a new register.
label: Modern Chinese
question: How can the beauty support a strong collar rather than compete with it?
idea: Keep the face warm, the crown controlled and the central proportions clear.
effect: Peach and coral create a warm counterpoint to the blue collar. The swept-back silhouette gives both the face and the garment space.
notes: Peach around the eyes and a muted coral lip bring warmth beside the cool blue collar.
The hair is swept away from the face with a close, controlled crown.
Soft brows and restrained colour sit beside a strong high collar and the clean shape of a calla lily.
adapt: If this direction speaks to you, tell us about the neckline, outfit changes and accessories you are considering. Mira's stated focus is modern bridal and New Chinese Style.

title: A little more presence.
label: Classic glamour
question: How do stronger eyes, lips and accessories hold together?
idea: Repeat the clarity of the makeup in a controlled hair silhouette.
effect: The crisp wing, red lip and sculpted side wave share a deliberate finish. Jewellery frames the profile rather than adding another loose shape.
notes: A crisp black wing and full lashes sit against a clearly defined red lip.
A sculpted side wave rolls into a low gathered shape, giving the look a controlled profile.
A jewelled headpiece and drop earrings follow the profile and set the scale of the styling.
adapt: Use this as a conversation about how much contrast feels like you. Yuki brings over ten years in bridal beauty and training in Hong Kong and South Korea.
